design: Outer leave-one-station-out; dynamic model has inner LOO; earlier/later time split. Defaults not tuned. Reported errors include explicitly labelled nearest fallback. No water screen in this station-only benchmark.
limitations: One late-autumn 24-hour period; temporal frames are correlated.
No independent seasonal evaluation or verified urban/basin/coastal labels.
Station altitude is the LOO target altitude; this does not measure DEM or GPS errors.
Municipal land-screen effects require separate field validation.
